concerns.text: The reframed target is 'deterministic structural feature vectors' (line counts, mean line length, heading/list markers, whitespace ratios) computed from the text of the MixSub-LLaMA-3.2 Text-Only Overlap CPU-Score parquet. That dataset is a text-overlap/score corpus; there is no cited evidence its text fields preserve line-level structure (newlines, headings, list markers). If the text is stored as flattened single-line strings, the structural extractor will produce near-constant/degenerate targets and the distillation study is vacuous. Add an explicit data-sufficiency check at preprocess time (e.g. variance/non-degeneracy assertion on the structural feature matrix, with graceful failure per FR-007) and name the fallback if the check fails, so the plan does not silently run on degenerate targets.
